name: camayoc_dora_change_deployed
description: DORA lead time last step (aegis-rb3): for each change merged in the window, the first SUCCEEDED deployment whose aegis:includesCommit names the change's merge commit. A change with deployedAt "none" is merged but not yet delivered; it is never credited to a deployment by time alone. A deployment earlier than the merge never delivers it, whatever it lists. Graphs are bound up front with VALUES (no per-graph string filter): the current and previous monthly window graphs, plus up to 16 exact staged-backfill graphs. An event older than the previous month is not read; its step reads as none/absent. includesCommit may come from a staged graph (corrections to existing deployments); the deployment itself must be in a deployment window graph.
template: PREFIX aegis: <http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/> SELECT ?change ?mergedAt (MIN(COALESCE(STR(?deployedAt0), "none")) AS ?deployedAt) WHERE { VALUES ?gm { <{changeNow}> <{changePrev}> <{staging1}> <{staging2}> <{staging3}> <{staging4}> <{staging5}> <{staging6}> <{staging7}> <{staging8}> <{staging9}> <{staging10}> <{staging11}> <{staging12}> <{staging13}> <{staging14}> <{staging15}> <{staging16}> } GRAPH ?gm { ?m a aegis:ChangeEvent ; aegis:changeId ?change ; aegis:changeRepository "{repository}" ; aegis:changeAction "merged" ; aegis:commitSha ?sha ; aegis:occurredAt ?mergedAt . } FILTER(STR(?mergedAt) >= "{start}" && STR(?mergedAt) < "{end}") OPTIONAL { VALUES ?gi { <{deployNow}> <{deployPrev}> <{staging1}> <{staging2}> <{staging3}> <{staging4}> <{staging5}> <{staging6}> <{staging7}> <{staging8}> <{staging9}> <{staging10}> <{staging11}> <{staging12}> <{staging13}> <{staging14}> <{staging15}> <{staging16}> } GRAPH ?gi { ?d aegis:includesCommit ?sha } VALUES ?gd { <{deployNow}> <{deployPrev}> } GRAPH ?gd { ?d a aegis:DeploymentEvent ; aegis:deploymentOutcome "succeeded" ; aegis:occurredAt ?deployedAt0 . } FILTER(STR(?deployedAt0) >= STR(?mergedAt)) } } GROUP BY ?change ?mergedAt ORDER BY ?mergedAt

params.name: repository
params.description: change repository as owner/repo

params.name: start
params.description: window start, RFC 3339 UTC (inclusive)

params.name: end
params.description: window end, RFC 3339 UTC (exclusive)

params.name: changeNow
params.description: change window graph for the window's end month, e.g. https://camayoc.local/window/change/2026-10

params.name: changePrev
params.description: change window graph for the month before changeNow

params.name: deployNow
params.description: deployment window graph for the window's end month, e.g. https://camayoc.local/window/deployment/2026-10

params.name: deployPrev
params.description: deployment window graph for the month before deployNow

params.name: staging1
